The inspection and organization of fishing gear have been completed.

At 19:20, I checked the weekend weather forecast on my phone and confirmed it would be sunny with no rain, making me even more excited about the camping and fishing plans. After that, I made a brief video call to my mother in Nantong to inform her of my weekend arrangements and reassure my parents. This covered preparing and eating dinner, checking the weather to ensure a smooth camping trip, and reaching out to family.

At 22:40, I lay in bed reflecting on the day: successfully guiding the apprentice, settling a favor for a classmate, finalizing weekend plans, helping a new colleague, and having all equipment ready. Feeling grounded and full of anticipation, I gradually fell asleep.

name: Morning Preparation
description: Waking up naturally at home on Saturday morning, I checked my phone to confirm it was sunny with a light breeze, and my mood was filled with anticipation. After washing up, I quickly had a simple breakfast (steamed buns and coffee), and then did a final check and moved the fishing gear that had been prepared the night before, making sure nothing was left behind. The camping equipment had been packed separately the previous evening.
location: No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai, in the home at Xingang Residential Area, Songjiang Science and Technology Park

name: Depart for the fishing spot
date: From 07:00:00 on September 13, 2025 to 08:45:00 on September 13, 2025
description: Driving from home, I headed to Rongle East Road in Songjiang District to meet up with my fishing friend Wu Zhiqiang. After exchanging greetings, we loaded the car and set off for the west bank of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu. The traffic was smooth along the way, and as we listened to the radio, we discussed the wind direction and water temperature, eventually deciding to head to a secluded fishing cove that was sheltered from the wind and rich in aquatic vegetation.
location: From "No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai" to "a wild fishing bay shore on the west bank of Dianshan Lake (near Huqingping Highway), Qingpu District, Shanghai" during the drive.

name: Finding Fishing Spots and Starting to Fish
description: After arriving at the west bank of Dianshan Lake, we parked the car and walked to the lakeside. Together with my fishing companion Wu Zhiqiang, we carefully observed the water conditions, wind direction, and the distribution of aquatic plants. Eventually, we selected a fishing spot with a water depth of about 2 meters, where there were aquatic plants near the shore and the area was relatively quiet and flat. The two of us used shovels to level the ground, set up folding chairs and equipment boxes, and prepared everything for fishing.
location: A certain wild fishing bay shore on the west bank of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai (near Huqingping Highway).

name: Morning Fishing and Communication
description: The fishing activity officially commenced. Wu Zhiqiang was responsible for baiting the fishing spot, while Yin Hao took charge of adjusting the float and preparing the bait. Shortly after casting the line, Yin Hao successfully caught a golden crucian carp weighing about half a kilogram, marking a promising start. Throughout the morning, the two immersed themselves in the tranquility of fishing, intermittently reeling in catches, primarily consisting of crucian carp and small bream. During this time, they quietly exchanged observations on the bait condition and float signals, while also sharing amusing anecdotes from their recent work and updates about their families, reflecting the everyday interactions between friends.
location: A certain wild fishing bay and inlet fishing spot on the western shore of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai (near Huqingping Highway).

name: Simple Meal and Rest by the Lake
description: As noon approached, the sun grew intense, so the two of them packed up their fishing rods and spread out a picnic mat in the shade of a tree to rest. Yin Hao took out bread, braised chicken legs, and apples, while Wu Zhiqiang brought tea and rice balls. They enjoyed a simple meal against the backdrop of the lake and mountains, sharing food, sipping tea, and taking a break. Yin Hao checked the morning’s catch (about three to four pounds of fish) and felt a sense of contentment, reflecting the satisfaction of a leisurely day.
location: Under the shade of trees beside a wild fishing bay inlet on the west bank of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai (near Huqingping Highway).

name: Afternoon Fishing and Unexpected Harvest
description: Fishing continued in the afternoon, with the bite slowing down a bit. However, around three o’clock, Yin Hao’s float suddenly sank, and when he lifted the rod, he felt a strong pull. After carefully playing the fish, he successfully landed a wild mandarin fish weighing about one and a half pounds, which delighted him and became the highlight of the day’s fishing. Wu Zhiqiang also caught several crucian carp in succession, and both felt they had a very fruitful day.
location: A wild fishing spot in a bay inlet on the western shore of Dianshan Lake (near Huqingping Highway), Qingpu District, Shanghai.

name: Ending the Fishing Activity and Returning the Anglers
description: Satisfied with their catch, they decided to pack up their fishing rods. The two carefully cleaned up the trash around the fishing spot, organized their catch into the cooler, and gathered all their gear. They then drove back the same way, dropping off their fishing buddy Wu Zhiqiang at the entrance of his residential complex. Yin Hao took half of the catch from the cooler—including several large crucian carp and the mandarin fish—and insisted that Wu Zhiqiang take it home for his family to enjoy, reflecting the spirit of sharing and camaraderie between friends. After agreeing to meet again next time, they bid each other farewell.
location: From "a wild fishing bay on the west bank of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai" to "the entrance of a residential area on Rongle East Road (near Rongdu Apartment) in Songjiang District, Shanghai" during the journey and upon arrival.

name: Returning home to rest and prepare for camping.
description: I drove back alone to my home in Songjiang. After arriving, I first dealt with the remaining catch (a few crucian carp), scaling and gutting them before washing and refrigerating them. Then I took a quick shower to wash off the sweat and dust, and changed into clean clothes. Next, I organized the camping gear (tent, sleeping bag, etc.) that I had prepared earlier and charged my electronic devices. Around 5 p.m., I received a WeChat message from my friend Gao Zhiyuan, notifying me that he was about to set off to pick me up.
location: No. 15, Lane 224, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai, in the home at Xingang Residential Area, Songjiang Science and Technology Park

name: Assemble and proceed to the camping base.
description: Move the camping gear in batches to the south gate of the community and wait. Friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng arrived on time in their SUV. After a brief greeting, the three of them worked together to load Yin Hao’s gear into the car. Yin Hao took a seat in the back, and the vehicle set off again toward Dianshan Lake. Along the way, the three excitedly discussed the barbecue menu for the evening and assigned tasks such as who would start the fire and chop the vegetables. The atmosphere in the car was lively, filled with anticipation for the camping trip.
location: From "No. 224 Lane, Xingang Road, Guangfulin Street, Songjiang District, Shanghai, South Gate of Xingang Community, Songjiang Science and Technology Park" to "Camping Bay Dianshan Lake Camp, No. 7918-1 Huqingping Highway, Qingpu District" during the journey.

name: Arriving at the Camp and Setting Up the Camp
description: Arriving at the pre-booked lakeside campsite, "Camping Bay." At the entrance service area, we completed the check-in process, paid the fees, and received our campsite number (Site 12, Zone C). We drove the car to the designated lakeside spot, admiring the lake view bathed in the glow of the setting sun. The three of us divided the tasks: Yin Hao and Gao Zhiyuan were responsible for setting up the three-person tent and the canopy, while Ma Xiaofeng unloaded the tables, chairs, lighting equipment, and the food supply box. In no time, we had the campsite set up sturdily and attractively, with the dining area illuminated to create a strong camping atmosphere.
location: Shanghai Qingpu District, Huqingping Highway No. 7918-1, Camping Bay Dianshan Lake Campground (Entrance Service Area and Campsite No. 12 in Zone C)

name: Outdoor BBQ Dinner and Night Chat with Friends
description: As dusk fell, the camp lights flickered on. The three friends divided tasks to prepare dinner: Gao Zhiyuan took charge of grilling steaks, lamb chops, and chicken wings, while Yin Hao tended to the portable stove to cook spicy ramen, and Ma Xiaofeng prepared vegetables and seasonings. The aroma of grilled meat filled the air. Gathered around the table, they cracked open chilled beers and colas, enjoying the warm barbecue and noodles. Throughout the meal, they chatted freely about amusing work stories, gaming battles, and the embarrassing moments Yin Hao and Gao Zhiyuan experienced during their military service. Laughter flowed continuously, reflecting their deep friendship and relaxed social atmosphere.
location: Camping Bay Dianshan Lake Camp, Plot 12, Area C, No. 7918-1 Huqingping Highway, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Nighttime Leisure and Bedtime Preparation
description: After dinner, the three of them made sure the charcoal fire was completely extinguished and carefully sorted and bagged the trash. Then, they brewed a pot of Pu’er tea and sat under the canopy, admiring the dazzling starry sky free from light pollution, occasionally catching sight of shooting stars streaking across. The topics of their nighttime conversation shifted from career plans and home-buying intentions to reminiscing about funny school memories and discussing their emotional lives. As the night deepened, they cleared the table and sealed the leftover food. Taking turns, they headed to the campground’s public washroom for a quick freshening up. Back in the tent, they laid out the moisture-proof mats and sleeping bags. Before bed, Yin Hao replied to his mother’s greeting message on WeChat, assuring her of his safety and setting an alarm for the next day. Amid the gentle lapping of the lake waves and the chirping of insects, the three bid each other goodnight and drifted off to sleep, filled with contentment and exhaustion.
location: Camping Bay Dianshan Lake Camp, Plot C, Site 12 and Public Wash Area, No. 7918-1 Huqingping Highway, Qingpu District, Shanghai

name: Morning Camping Activity
date: From 07:00:00 on September 14, 2025 to 08:30:00 on September 14, 2025
description: Yin Hao woke up naturally in the fresh air by the shores of Dianshan Lake, quickly tidied up his personal sleeping bag and belongings, and changed into quick-drying clothes. He then joined his friends Gao Zhiyuan and Ma Xiaofeng to cook noodles and fry eggs for breakfast using a portable stove. After the meal, they took a leisurely stroll along the lakeshore, enjoying the tranquility of the Sunday morning while discussing the starry sky from the previous night and the day's planned activities. Yin Hao also inspected the public areas of the campsite to ensure everything was in order.
location: A camping site by the lakeside on the west bank of Dianshan Lake in Qingpu District, Shanghai.

They found it beneficial for core strength training and felt joyful throughout the experience. After the activity, the three efficiently divided tasks to pack up the campsite: dismantling the tent, rolling up the moisture-proof mat, packing away the cooking utensils, cleaning up, and taking away all the trash. The equipment was wiped clean and loaded into Gao Zhiyuan’s SUV. Yin Hao was responsible for the final inspection to ensure the campsite was restored to its original condition.

After a brief stay of about 15 minutes, they continued driving and eventually arrived at the Xingang Road residential area in Songjiang.

Qingpu District, West Bank of Dianshan Lake
